content: File upload security (OWASP File Upload Cheat Sheet): client-supplied Content-Type/MIME header and file extension are both attacker-controlled and must not be trusted alone; validate actual file content via magic-byte/signature inspection server-side, enforce a strict allowlist (xlsx/csv only) plus a hard file-size cap, and never derive trust from filename. Defense-in-depth: extension allowlist + magic-byte check + size limit + parse in a sandboxed/isolated step, since malformed files can also be used for DoS via memory exhaustion or zip-bomb-style expansion (xlsx is a zip container).
